integrity: The theorem is proved by an exact algebraic reduction. Prime squares are excluded separately, and the squarefree semiprime condition is transformed bidirectionally into a divisor condition. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exact only for the multiplicity-two layer \(\Omega(n)=2\). It does not settle infinitude of semiprime counterbalanced numbers or classify higher-multiplicity solutions.
title: Exact divisor parametrization of semiprime counterbalanced numbers
